spans.text: Bang!
Tsk!
Every Paradeus trooper she guns down, three more take its place.
Why?
Bang!
Bang!
A large swarm of Paradeus units have appeared to seal off Ange's escape route, as if they've been hiding in the mansion from the very start.
She has already given up on getting out through the front doors and is planning to smash the first window she sees.
But these white troopers that are closing in towards her clearly don't intend to give her the chance.
...Before they came inside, both AK-15 and RPK-16 had said there was no danger.
RPK...
Target...detected.
Go to hell!
Smash!
After smashing the glass with her bionic arm, Ange grabs the disused fire axe without thinking and buries it straight into the head of an incoming Strelet.
The Strelet falls limply onto its knees, but two more appear behind him in the hallway.
Bang bang!
The bullets impact near Ange's feet. She raises her pistol and fires accurately into their helmets.
Dark, thick blood oozes out from the bullet holes, but the Strelets merely lurch before raising their weapons again.
At this distance, even with a clean shot in the head, Ange still can't shoot them down with a pistol of this caliber.
Dammit.
Ange turns and flees.
Luckily⁠—she wonders if that's even the word⁠—these guys seem to be holding back when firing on her.
They are definitely trying to avoid killing her⁠—all their shots are aimed at non-fatal spots; some even just shoot at the floor right by her feet.
...It's not that hard to figure out what kind of order they've been given.
You want me alive, eh...?
If she'd known the mansion was a trap, she would've chosen to stay with AK-15.
A single lapse of judgment has led Ange into this difficult position.
There is nothing but static on her communicator. She can't tell what the situation is with AN-94.
On the other hand...
Boom!
Explosions erupt periodically to the west.
It's pretty easy to pinpoint AK-15.
Charging outside could be risky. It may be better to double back and regroup with AK-15.
...She won't lose.
Target...detected.
Crap.
When turning a corner, Ange runs straight into two more Strelets.
Ange raises her pistol instinctively, but her enemies are faster this time.
Bang!
Ugh!
A bullet hits the pistol in her hand, the shockwave numbing her fingers.
The pistol is sent flying from her grip, and the barrel is completely distorted.
Meanwhile, the other Strelet now has its weapon trained on Ange. Its finger rests on the trigger threateningly.
Ange stumbles back a few steps until her back is up against the wall.
...She has been cornered.
Bang!
An ear-splitting gunshot rings out from behind the Strelets, and the powerful impact blows the one aiming at Ange into two halves right at the waist.
The sudden explosion of gore and armor fragments startles the other Strelet, and that moment of shock is all it takes...
Bang!
Its brains are now splattered on the floor.
Miss Ange.
...When did you start wielding a 512?
When I first realized pistols wouldn't do much to these guys.
We'll chat later. We've got to get out as quickly as we can.
Where's 94?
...Gray is here with Nytos and her forces.
All my men are dead; Frau 94 is slowing them down to buy us some time.
Ange understands right away.
...It's a trap, and they have fallen straight into it.
RPK-16 is her subordinate, but she did not find out about her treachery until it was too late.
Ange is responsible for the deaths of Light's subordinates.
Miss Ange?
We're out of time! We must go now!
Light looks at Ange, who is still rooted to the spot, and implores urgently.
I...I know...
Her hand is still shaking.
How do you plan to get us out?
Comms are down... We're probably being jammed again.
But the range of the interference must be limited.
There are a lot of private access areas in the neighborhood. We'll be able to call for help once we make it out of the mansion.
That is if we can make it out at all.
We'll be fine! They can't stop us and...
...Where are Miss 15 and Miss 16?
Light can finally put a finger of what exactly has been bothering him since a while ago.
Why is Ange all by herself?
AK-15 is fighting RPK-16. We're on our own.
They're...
Light looks aghast.
...But he soon figures it out.
In any case, this isn't the time to talk. I took note of the nearest exit when I came in.
Let's go!
Right!
Ange nods. Light reloads his shotgun and takes the lead.
The moment he turns—
Ange catches a glimpse of gray.
Watch out!
What...
Crunch.
The sharp blade slices through both the 512 and Light's body.
Without spilling even a single drop of blood, the glinting blade halts just centimeters away from Ange's face.
Light cannot even react in time.
...There you are.
Angelia.
Miss Ange... Run.
Gray retracts her tail without sparing a glance for the prey whose arm she has just cleaved off.
Light calls out to Ange hoarsely.

There is a massive, gaping wound on the left side of his torso. Blood starts gushing out of his shoulder like a fountain; his arm is dangling precariously from his torso by a single piece of skin next to the rib cage.
The blood splashes onto Ange's face.
Finally, he collapses onto the floor like a ragdoll...
And Ange's shattered heart falls along with him.
